name: The Kobeissi Letter
text:
BREAKING: Nvidia's, $NVDA, Board of Directors announces it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO of the company.

The board also says they will not be accepting any questions regarding Jensen Huang on their earnings call.

name: The Kobeissi Letter
text:
BREAKING: Jensen Huang releases his first public statement since resigning as CEO of Nvidia, $NVDA, and says he is willing to return as CEO.

Jensen Huang specifically says he will return as CEO if the board asks him to.

Full statement:

“Since my departure, I’ve seen an outpouring of calls from Nvidia’s employees, investors, business partners, and customers for me to return as CEO. If the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO.”

We continue to believe Nvidia’s board should leave the possibility of Huang returning as CEO open.

name: The Kobeissi Letter
text:
Nvidia's board should act now.

We believe Jensen Huang's newly released statement is only further evidence that he resigned from his position as CEO of Nvidia, $NVDA, in the heat of the moment.

Today, Jensen made it clear that he is willing to return, calling it an "honor" to answer calls for him to return as CEO.

Nvidia's board should now acknowledge, at the very least, that pending the results of the independent investigation, the door for Jensen to return has not closed.

Preserving this option is not a commitment to reinstatement, but rather an acknowledgment that the board's ultimate decision should be guided by the findings of the investigation and the long-term interests of shareho
